notes: v3: explain-and-approve workflow (red to-do -> note -> approve -> orange un-mapped bucket), CSV export to accounting, notes.json bake loop (build_data --notes / input-dir notes.json), units reframed (purchased-to-job + from-stock) vs sold. Fleet value change is an approvable standing item. v3.1: Trailing 60 window; over-pull aging — soft orange grace ≤3 days after job close (weekend catch-up), hard red day 4+. v3.2: window anchor = built-date minus one (never a partial today); T90 feeds live. build_data.py frozen in repo (plaintext, no secrets) — nightly runs fetch + sha-verify it; edits bump build_plain_sha256. v3.4: null-guards on DATA.month — with <2 stock snapshots the month anchor degrades to an 'unavailable' note instead of throwing on load (blank page); nightly runs now stage the month-end Aggregate Inventory Stock Reports from Claude Docs/Inventory Month End/_Input (engine picks the 2 newest by Filters date) and headless-render-verify before publish.
